reply_text:
I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. I don't have a way to post into Slack on a timer. My scheduled jobs run in my own session, and their output isn't delivered back to this channel.

What I can do: post a "Coastal week ahead" digest from #coastal-team and #coastal-random whenever you ask, and draft it for you to review first. I've replied in the thread on your message with this, and I posted a short correction there because my first reply was wrong about the scheduler.
